data.description:
## Context

F48 is approved. The vendored Jira Data Center Dockerfile names an upstream path but omits the source revision, license identifier, protected license text, and modification statement.

## Plan

- Record pycontribs/jira commit e3c7b167b065660605645cef7f101cbb324772e4 and source path docker/jira-test-image/Dockerfile.
- Add the BSD-2-Clause license text from the pinned upstream revision.
- State the local modifications without claiming an unmodified copy.
- Preserve Dockerfile instructions and existing Atlassian product licensing discussion.
- Add no mechanical prose or character scanner.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Provenance names the exact repository, revision, and source path.
- [ ] The stored upstream license text matches the pinned revision.
- [ ] The modification statement identifies local changes.
- [ ] Dockerfile instructions, base digest, Jira version, and entrypoint remain unchanged.
- [ ] Existing Atlassian product licensing discussion remains unchanged.
- [ ] No connected Jira Data Center harness runs during verification.
- [ ] Focused existing Dockerfile checks, license digest comparison, lint, type, and whitespace checks pass.
data.title: Record pinned Jira Data Center Dockerfile provenance
